summary: Login form vulnerable to SQL injection

validation.note: tautology and contradiction return identical result counts for every form

remediation.config_change: Replace string concatenation with a parameterized query (placeholders and bound arguments) for POST /login.php parameter username; reject input that fails a strict allowlist before it reaches the database; run the application's database role with SELECT-only grants where the endpoint only reads.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:username "@detectSQLi" "id:9100001,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay sqli virtual patch f-d4369cfd2b4af182',tag:'assay/sqli'"
{"class":"sqli","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-d4369cfd2b4af182","id":9100001,"rule":"SecRule ARGS:username \"@detectSQLi\" \"id:9100001,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay sqli virtual patch f-d4369cfd2b4af182',tag:'assay/sqli'\""}

summary: Login form vulnerable to authentication bypass

validation.note: resource answers 200 without credentials; that is auth-missing, not a bypass

remediation.config_change: Trace the authentication decision for POST /login.php to a single server-side check that cannot be influenced by client input; invalidate sessions created through the bypass; add a regression test.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@rx ^/login\.php" "id:9100006,phase:2,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay auth-bypass virtual patch f-40e548f3453e2dab',tag:'assay/auth-bypass'"
{"class":"auth-bypass","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-40e548f3453e2dab","id":9100006,"rule":"SecRule REQUEST_URI \"@rx ^/login\\.php\" \"id:9100006,phase:2,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay auth-bypass virtual patch f-40e548f3453e2dab',tag:'assay/auth-bypass'\""}
